reviews.text:
My dog is a 5lb toy Cavapoo, he’s very friendly and extremely sociable, but after leaving this place he was  was shaking for two days and we were unable to pick him up. This was the first and last time we will EVER take him here.
We wanted to try something closer to our place, but it was our biggest regret.
I Left a message for owner to call me back and never got a response. After inspecting him further he had dry skin patches on his chest, not sure if the groomer got too closed when they were shaving him  or just grabbed him too rough.
Not only did he have a terrible experience but the hair cut was just so awful.
If I could give them 0 stars I would. Do not go here.

I take my two long haired cats here for a sanitary trim and a bath. They do an excellent job with both cats and I’ve never had an issue. It’s expensive (about $180) but my cats always come back smelling great (and sometimes with a cute bandanna).

Super attentive and easily the best groomers I’ve ever been to. My sweet Persian cat, Major, always comes home relaxed, fluffy, and looking good as heck with his little lion cut 🦁💕 You can tell they genuinely care about the animals and take their time with them. Absolutely love this place and would recommend them to anyone with a pooch or kitty.

I bring my baby here for daycare and its fantastic. The staff is so sweet and you can tell they genuinely love all the pups. I get pictures and videos throughout the day which warms my heart. I've watched them playing with my puppy (from afar lol like a creeper) before I pick him up and its the cutest thing ever. I mean I saw the love and care they put into it. I absolutely love this place. Great communication, affordable, and just plain awesome. Thank you!!! Can't wait to try the grooming services
The cut my dog hair, with not permission, my dog is a husky and the can’t do it
Simba always seems happy when he comes out of his bath, but above all, the smell lasts for days. Excellent service, I try to recommend it to everyone who asks me.

I just literally noticed my babies uneven haircut. I am so upset. On Friday January 16 2026, on my birthday to top it off, took my boys to this place and I spoke to the owner Claudia and I specifically told her that I did not want their haircuts to be close to their skin. She gave me a chart to look at and I chose level number five. She told me it would take four hours when I came back, they told me that I had to come back at 7 o’clock because supposedly there was another dog in front of my two boys. I don’t understand how they groom one of mine and skipped my second one so they can take care of someone else else’s dog that’s very unprofessional. I still gave them a tip  because that’s how I am, but Gracie is the Groomer and she Really ruined my Shih Tzu’s cuts Tonight I was lying next to my cinnamon, and a noticed the uneven cut by his stomach, and I was so upset to be honest. I wasn’t even planning to write a review for the fact that they cut their hair too short when I asked them not to, but when I saw this tonight, I was so furious that I decided to post a review and I will never ever take my babies  there again. I gave them a one star because I can’t give a zero star because they require that you give a star in order to write a review. To  be honest not even a one star I would have given this place. I sent a picture so you can see how awful this cut is another thing they never asked for my babies’s medical records. That’s how unprofessional they are. This place should be investigated as see comments of how good they are. That is nonsense. I regret going there I am so upset.

I tried so many places in Astoria!
Every time I was disappointed… until I found Claudia she gave my bernedoodle such a beautiful hair cut !
I highly recommend Dog Planet I will be back for more !
Great grooming. My dog loved going there and the staff love her too. Super friendly staff
Best experience. Love the way they groomed my pup and listened to what I was looking for. Will be back.

I don't bring my dog here nearly enough because I've moved further away, but compared to the other dog groomers in Woodside or LIC, it's worth the trek to Astoria to get him groomed here. Prices aren't the best but that's everywhere else too right now. At least you'll get a great service here!

Everything was fine, but when they cut her hair, they hurt her in two places on one of her paws. I have the clippers, but I'm afraid to use them precisely because of that. I don't think I'll take her back.
I am happy I took my baby here. I was a little hesitant as I had bad experience with groomers . They were very nice , friendly and helpful. I loved Bowie’s trim . We will be back.
Great communications especially with follow-ups, could be better on the specifications that’s needed on the days of the service, but I’d still give dog planet a strong 8/9 out of 10

It was a waste of my time. They told me to pick up my dog from the floor because they didn’t want dogs in the floor which was incoherent because it’s a dog place.  Poor customer service and they would charge you EXTRA for whatever you wanted them to do and if you added something that they would charge you even more!! Not to mention they even cut my dog in the belly. Find yourself another groomer.
Claudia is amazing. Our dog has been getting groomed here since she was a puppy. I had to use someone else once and immediately regretted it. Highly recommend!

Horrible! There is a dog left alone, shaking in the store at 10 PM with the lights out. Several people have tried calling and reaching out, but no one is responding. This is absolutely ridiculous, and you should be ashamed of treating this poor animal like this!

As I battle cancer, I return later or leave home earlier  for my treatments.
My little guy waits patiently and snuggles close when he knows I need his care.
His comfort and care, provided by others, are so important to me.
Rawpawzel has always welcomed him with polite and efficient service.
Definitely, fairly priced!
Never a worry of how he  was treated.
Cause when you know you JUST  know, he was treated very well.

Thank you.
